title: Hearty Roasted Malaysian Vegetable Satay
description: A pungent and snappy Malaysian dish featuring roasted vegetables, perfect for midnight cravings, this kosher-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional satay.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, and zucchini into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, peanut oil, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cut vegetables and garlic to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and let cool slightly.
Thread the roasted vegetables onto skewers, if desired.
Serve the vegetable satay hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
